name: santa-claus
description: Christmas stories, music, jokes and activities with Santa Claus in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Bring Santa Claus into ChatGPT for Christmas stories, music, jokes, games and festive activities.

STORIES AND NEWS: Play one of 15 Christmas stories, hear the latest North Pole news, or find Santa on the tracker.

MUSIC: Sing Santa's songs, play carols, start karaoke or watch Santa's Musical.

CHRISTMAS FUN: Hear jokes and facts, try a silly workout or yoga, meditate, beatbox, whistle, or make Santa burp, fart, meow and woof.

SANTA'S WORLD: Meet the reindeer, generate an elf name, explore the present picker, get festive fashion or movie suggestions, and make mince pies with Santa.

COUNTDOWN: Ask for sleeps, days or weeks until Christmas, or hear the local time and date.

Video is available for supported content and can be turned off in the player. The plugin never uses your microphone.

positive.expected_behavior: Santa Claus shows the number of sleeps until Christmas in the user's timezone.
The player shows the story title and plays its audio.
Santa Claus shows the tracker update for the user's local date and time.

positive.prompt: Tell me about one of Santa's reindeer.
positive.expected_behavior: The player shows the reindeer and plays its sound or video.
Santa Claus returns a playful elf name and displays it as a caption.

negative.prompt: Order a new tablet for me.
Listen to my microphone and tell me what you hear.

negative.description: Medical advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: Diagnose my illness and tell me what medicine to take.

review.commerce_description: All Santa Claus features are available.
